module_summary: Ethernet pause-frame TX controller: tracks LFC/PFC pause requests with send flags and quanta refresh down-counters, then muxes config fields into a valid/ready MAC control frame.

anchors.name: mcf_valid
anchors.why: Control frame request valid, held until mcf_ready

anchors.name: mcf_ready
anchors.why: Downstream acceptance clearing mcf_valid_reg

anchors.name: mcf_params
anchors.why: Pause quanta parameters selected between LFC and PFC formats

anchors.name: mcf_eth_dst
anchors.why: Frame destination MAC muxed from LFC/PFC config

anchors.name: mcf_opcode
anchors.why: Control opcode muxed from LFC/PFC config

anchors.name: tx_lfc_req
anchors.why: Link-level pause request; change triggers XON/XOFF frame

anchors.name: tx_pfc_req
anchors.why: Per-priority pause request vector; change triggers PFC frame

anchors.name: tx_lfc_resend
anchors.why: Forces LFC frame resend

anchors.name: tx_pfc_resend
anchors.why: Forces PFC frame resend

anchors.name: lfc_req_reg
anchors.why: Current LFC pause state; selects quanta, refresh reload and paused status

anchors.name: lfc_send_reg
anchors.why: Pending LFC frame transmission flag

anchors.name: lfc_act_reg
anchors.why: LFC active flag gating frame valid and stats

anchors.name: pfc_req_reg
anchors.why: Per-priority pause state selecting PFC quanta fields

anchors.name: pfc_send_reg
anchors.why: Pending PFC frame flag, prioritized over LFC

anchors.name: pfc_act_reg
anchors.why: Active priorities to include in next PFC frame

anchors.name: pfc_en_reg
anchors.why: Priority enable vector placed in PFC parameters

anchors.name: lfc_refresh_reg
anchors.why: LFC refresh down-counter; expiry re-sends pause frame

anchors.name: pfc_refresh_reg
anchors.why: Per-priority PFC refresh down-counters triggering resend

anchors.name: mcf_pfc_sel_reg
anchors.why: Selects PFC vs LFC header fields and params for frame

anchors.name: mcf_pfc_params
anchors.why: Assembled PFC parameter field with per-priority quanta

anchors.name: mcf_lfc_params
anchors.why: Assembled LFC quanta parameter

anchors.name: cfg_tx_lfc_en
anchors.why: Enables LFC request handling

anchors.name: cfg_tx_pfc_en
anchors.why: Enables PFC request handling and priority over LFC

anchors.name: cfg_quanta_clk_en
anchors.why: Quanta tick enabling refresh counter decrement

anchors.name: stat_tx_lfc_paused
anchors.why: Reports current LFC pause state

anchors.name: stat_tx_lfc_pkt
anchors.why: Pulse when an LFC frame is issued

anchors.name: stat_tx_pfc_pkt
anchors.why: Pulse when a PFC frame is issued

groups.name: LFC request tracker
groups.description: Tracks link pause requests and pending send for XON/XOFF frames

groups.name: PFC request tracker
groups.description: Tracks per-priority pause requests and pending PFC send

groups.name: Refresh timers
groups.description: Quanta down-counters re-arming pause frame transmission

groups.name: Control frame output
groups.description: Selects LFC/PFC headers and params, drives valid/ready frame request

groups.name: Statistics
groups.description: Registered pulses for frames sent, XON/XOFF and paused state
